semantic_question_used: Whether effluent discharge occurred during Federal FY2025 such that the monitoring and reporting requirement for TSS daily maximum mass load (lb/d), conditioned on the permit limit comment 'WHEN DISCHARGING', was applicable for this permit limit row.
interpretation: Discharge from Outfall 001 (backwash water) occurred during Federal FY2025, so the conditional monitoring requirement was applicable. The permit authorizes intermittent backwash discharge and ties TSS monitoring frequency to discharge occurrence via footnote '*1 When discharging.' DMR data for limit value 3610840341 report numeric daily-maximum TSS mass loads in lb/d for every FY2025 monitoring month (October 2024 through September 2025), with no NODI codes and companion nonzero flow reports on the same limit-set schedule. This establishes that discharge occurred in each evaluated month and that conditional monitoring was required rather than waived by a documented no-discharge period.
